summary: At step 1322, the forced Ctrl-T target selector has moved to a fountain but JavaScript leaves the prior chained-Knight description on the top line. The source cause is pager.c symbol refinement: sink and fountain both use the active { byte, so C do_screen_description() calls lookat() and gets fountain from the actual S_fountain cmap index. JavaScript pager.js lookatOrdinaryTerrain() refuses S_sink and S_fountain; getpos.js:auto_describe() catches that refusal, leaving the prior h-prefixed message. The actionable goal is a pager source port that handles these ordinary cmap descriptions through the shared do_screen_description()/lookat path. The later fountain.c fate-30 gushing refusal at step 1329 remains a separate blocker.

source.branch: The whole ordinary cmap description branch is relevant. In C pager.c do_screen_description() (1247-1613), the active { byte matches both defsym entries S_sink (index 36) and S_fountain (index 37), so found exceeds one and the looked-at coordinate is refined by lookat(). C lookat() (657-801) handles cmap glyphs with a switch and its default returns defsyms[symidx].explanation, yielding fountain for the actual S_fountain tile. JavaScript pager.js do_screen_description() (854-969) takes the same ambiguous-symbol path, but lookatOrdinaryTerrain() (818-849) omits S_sink and S_fountain from its supported set and throws. auto_describe() catches UnsupportedWhatisError, suppressing the new fountain text and retaining the previous chained-Knight line. Add the missing ordinary cmap behavior with the C default semantics while preserving special context-sensitive branches.
callers: js/getpos.js:auto_describe() (407-431) invokes pager.js do_screen_description() before each forced target input; the catch of UnsupportedWhatisError is the direct production manifestation.
nethack-c/upstream/src/getpos.c:auto_describe() (639-662) invokes pager.c do_screen_description() and emits firstmatch through custompline(), then getpos() (771-1144) refreshes the target loop.

nethack-c/upstream/src/teleport.c:scrolltele() (849-915) calls getpos(&cc, TRUE, "the desired position") at 892; js/teleport.js:scrolltele() (1381-1440) calls getpos(cc, true, ...) at 1422. tele()/tele() delegate to this production path, entered by step 1320 Ctrl-T.

The shared pager implementation is also used by js/cmd.js do_look()/what_is and the C pager callers of do_screen_description(); keep the correction in pager.js rather than adding a teleport-specific message.
dependencies: nethack-c/upstream/include/defsym.h:133-137 maps S_sink and S_fountain to the same { byte; JS symbols.js cmap_symbol_byte(), symbol_data.js CMAP_EXPLANATIONS, and getpos.js featureSymbolMatches()/findTerrainFeature() supply the corresponding active symbol and target scan.

C pager.c add_cmap_descr() (1131-1241) preserves first match and appends shared-symbol alternatives before lookat(); JS pager.js generic cmap accumulation and appendDescription() must retain this order and then refine the actual tile.

C pager.c lookat() defaults ordinary cmap entries to defsyms[symidx].explanation, while JS pager.js lookatOrdinaryTerrain() currently throws for several cmap indices. At minimum S_sink and S_fountain are required for this witness; review the complete ordinary cmap set before removing the fail-closed guard.

C getpos.c auto_describe() uses custompline(SUPPRESS_HISTORY | OVERRIDE_MSGTYPE | NO_CURS_ON_U); JS getpos.js currently uses ttyPline(). The first mismatch is explained by the unsupported fountain refinement, but a fix should preserve this message-window contract when completing the pager branch.

The later step-1329 refusal is independent fountain.c drinkfountain() fate 30: C fountain.c:243-254 selects the fate and :119-161 dogushforth()/gush(), while js/fountain.js:647-648 still refuses the gushing-forth branch. It remains outside this pager divergence-fix scope.
